summary: Verified admin dashboard routing bug fix and regressions. All 5 scenarios PASS: (1) Admin login + 'Dashboard' nav click -> /admin with tab-overview, tab-agencies, tab-verifications and populated providers-table. (2) Direct /dashboard as admin redirects to /admin. (3) /admin/agencies shows agencies-table with 10 agencies including Rose Noire (Paris, 3/3 live) and Vienna Elite (Vienna, 2/2 live); expand row reveals companion profiles (Lena, Victoria); Suspend/Delete actions rendered per row. (4) Provider (provider1@lumiere.com) lands on /dashboard, NOT /admin. (5) Agency (agency@test.com) lands on /dashboard (agency roster view), NOT /admin. Regression on admin Overview: providers-table populated (62 total providers, Sophia visible).

issues: React hydration warnings: <span> child of <tbody>, <tr> child of <span> — caused by a wrapping instrumentation <span data-ve-dynamic="true"> injected inside <tbody> around each <tr>. Not a functional issue but produces console errors on every admin page load.

action_items: No functional fixes required for the reported routing bug — it is fully resolved.

(Low priority) Investigate the ve-dynamic <span> wrapper being inserted between <tbody> and <tr> in AdminDashboard.js (~line 319-321) and AdminAgencies.js (~line 187-190); it produces hydration warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: DashboardRouter admin -> /admin redirect works as intended.
SiteHeader role-aware Dashboard link correctly points to /admin for admin role.
seed_data_creation: None. Existing seed (Rose Noire, Vienna Elite) verified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin routing fix verified. If revisiting, note preview environment sometimes doesn't reach 'networkidle' — use wait_until='domcontentloaded' + wait_for_timeout(2500). Login sets httpOnly session_token cookie via POST /api/auth/login. Hydration warnings from ve-dynamic span wrappers are pre-existing instrumentation artifacts, not regressions.
